page.title: सहयोग विवरण
page.intro: एक सहयोग का अपना पृष्ठ — कौन सा पूल, वह कैसे बंद हुआ, और कितने योगदान प्राप्त होने की पुष्टि हुई।
$comment.pagination: ⭐⭐ STORY 11b.3b (Task 3, AC4) — ORDINARY UI LABELS MINTED AT THEIR OWN RENDER SITE, ⛔ NOT ratified copy and ⛔ NOT trust copy. ⭐ The precedent is `label.branch` (11b.17) and `upi_intent.vpa_label` (8-17); the non-render-site rule governs the Panel's RATIFIED message block ONLY, which is consumed from `sahyog-shared` BY NAME. ⚠⛔ DELIBERATELY ⛔ NOT resolved from `sahyog-drive`'s identical pair: that is the INDEX's namespace, and reaching into another SURFACE's copy couples two pages' wording so that re-wording one silently re-words the other. ⭐ Cross-namespace reuse in this file is for SHARED vocabularies (`sahyog-shared`'s stage words, `contribution`'s `contributor_list.*`) — ⛔ `sahyog-drive` is ⛔ not one. ⛔⛔ AND THERE IS ⛔ NO "show all" AND ⛔ NO PAGE-SIZE LABEL HERE, EVER: FR-91 forbids bulk export from the public side, and a control offering a bigger page is the export affordance wearing a pagination costume.
$comment.amount_raised: ⭐⭐ STORY 11b.3b (AC3b) — `{amount}` ARRIVES ALREADY FORMATTED AND CARRIES ITS OWN ₹. ⚠⛔⛔ THERE IS DELIBERATELY ⛔ NO LITERAL ₹ IN EITHER VALUE, AND ADDING ONE SHIPS `₹₹`. The render site passes `formatCurrency(amountInr, 'en')` (`[driveToken].astro`), and `currency.ts` returns `₹ 1,37,000` — symbol, house space and Indian lakh/crore grouping included. ⭐ The shipped precedent is `sahyog-shared`'s `index_line.*`, which carries ⛔ no literal ₹ for exactly this reason; its `$comment.message_block` states it in terms (*"a literal ₹ would ship ₹₹"*) and records DROPPING the ₹ the Panel's §8.1 shorthand wrote. ⚠⛔ FOUND 2026-09-15 as a SHIPPED defect on this key, in BOTH locales: every test stubbed the label and so bypassed `t()` AND `formatCurrency` — the same shape as the 11a.2 `{{max}}` vs `{max}` defect the render site's own header names. ⭐ The regression leg now resolves this key through the REAL `t()` in both locales. ⚠⛔ `formatCurrency(…, 'en')` ⛔ NEVER the page locale: money is OPERATIONAL data and renders LATIN even in the Hindi UI (amendment-A2, `currency.ts`).
collecting.title: यह सहयोग जारी है
collecting.body: योगदान खुले हैं। अंतिम परिणाम यहाँ तब दिखेगा जब संग्रह की अवधि पूरी हो जाएगी और मिलान निपट जाएगा। तब तक यह पृष्ठ केवल वही दिखाता है जिसकी प्राप्ति की पुष्टि हो चुकी है।
outcome.fully_funded: चक्र उस सहयोग के साथ पूरा हुआ जिसकी आवश्यकता थी।
outcome.under_funded: चक्र पूरा हुआ। ट्रस्ट ने परिवार के प्रति अपना दायित्व निभाया।
outcome.partial: चक्र पूरा हुआ। मिलान अभी चल रहा है।
appeal.title: अपील पर पुनर्विचार
appeal.lineage: यह दावा पहले अस्वीकृत हुआ, फिर अपील में गया, और अस्वीकृति पलट दी गई।
disposition.reconsideration_on_merits: दावे पर गुण-दोष के आधार पर पुनर्विचार हुआ
outage.title: यह सहयोग अभी लोड नहीं हो सका
outage.body: यह हमारी ओर की समस्या है — न तो यह सहयोग के बारे में कोई कथन है और न ट्रस्ट की गतिविधि के बारे में। कृपया कुछ क्षण बाद पुनः प्रयास करें।
bank.title: यह सहयोग किसे मिलता है
bank.group_label: इस अभियान के लिए दर्ज नामिती
bank.equal_nominees: दोनों नाम समान रूप से दर्ज हैं। किसी एक को दूसरे पर वरीयता नहीं है।
$comment.label_branch: ⭐⭐ MINTED AT STORY 11b.17 (Task 5), AT ITS OWN RENDER SITE — and it is ⛔ NOT ratified copy. ⚠⛔ RECORDED PRECISELY BECAUSE AN EARLIER DRAFT CALLED IT RATIFIED, which left AC4 ORDERED, FORBIDDEN and UNHOMED at once — the one shape a dev cannot act on. ⭐ Traced live 2026-09-13: ⛔ NO clause names `branch`. `2026-09-04-190` cl.2 ratifies 'Nominee Name' (which is `label.account_holder`'s VALUE, ⛔ not this key), and `-193` cl.3 fences the SHARED STAGE/LINE VOCABULARY in `sahyog-shared` — ⛔ not every field label. ⭐ `label.branch` ('Branch' / 'शाखा') was an ORDINARY label DELETED AS COLLATERAL at `45547a7b`, when story A (`11b-11`) withdrew the public banking tier under `2026-09-04-190` cl.1 — so this restores a label, ⛔ it does ⛔ not author trust copy. ⭐ THE PRECEDENT IS `8-17`, which minted `upi_intent.vpa_label` = 'UPI ID' at ITS OWN render site (`5ffb366a`) under `-212` Consequence 5. ⚠⛔ The ⛔ non-render-site rule governs the PANEL'S MESSAGE BLOCK ⛔ ONLY (AC10 / Task 5d), which is ratified text and is consumed from `sahyog-shared` BY NAME. ⚠ `branch` is GENUINELY NULLABLE on the substrate ⇒ an absent branch OMITS THE ROW — ⛔ never a placeholder, ⛔ never 'Not recorded'. ⚠⛔⛔ AMENDED 2026-09-14 BY `#decision-2026-09-14-217` cl.2 (Trustee-ratified, DR + KB) — ⛔ THE PRIOR SENTENCE HERE IS SUPERSEDED AND IS RECORDED, ⛔ NOT SILENTLY DROPPED. It read: *"⛔ It is ⛔ NOT `bank_name`'s twin: that column is NOT NULL with no non-empty CHECK, so its empty value is a FAULT and degrades to the decrypt sentinel. ⛔ Do ⛔ not write one guard for both."* ⛔⛔ THAT PREMISE IS FALSE AND THE REMEDY IT PRESCRIBES IS NOW FORBIDDEN BY NAME: `bank_name` is Tier-3 PLAINTEXT and is ⛔ NEVER encrypted, so the sentinel reported a CRYPTO FAILURE THAT DID ⛔ NOT HAPPEN. ⭐ An unrecorded `bank_name` now arrives as `null` and OMITS ITS ROW, exactly as `branch` does. ⚠⛔ THEY ARE STILL ⛔ NOT TWINS AND ⛔ ONE GUARD MUST ⛔ NOT SERVE BOTH — ⭐ same posture, ⛔ different provenance: `branch` is a NULLABLE COLUMN, while `bankName`'s `null` is MINTED AT THE API BOUNDARY from an empty/whitespace value. ⛔ The THREE Tier-1 coordinates KEEP the sentinel — ⭐ for them the failure is REAL.
